text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text:
Everyone at the Orphanage and at the Gourmet Guild
seems to be so friendly with Rem, it makes me happy.
choice_data_list: She actually scares me a little.
She's the one always helping us out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【サレンディア救護院】の人たちも
【美食殿】の人たちも、
レムに良くしてくれてるみたいでうれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text:
She did all the housework back in Roswaal's mansion too.
We appreciated her in Lugnica, and it's just the same in Landosol.
I should do something to thank her myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ロズワールの屋敷でも
家事全般なんでもこなしてたもの。
ルグニカにいた頃もそうだけど
ランドソルでも本当に助かってるわ。
私も
なにかして恩返ししなきゃね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thank you.
But until recently, she never really opened up to anyone but Ram.
...It's all thanks to Subaru. Wherever could he be now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
ありがとう。
でも
こんな風に
ラム以外に心を開き始めたのって
最近なの。
……
その原因のスバルってば、
今どこにいるのかしら──

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text:
I guess you did first see her hurling that spiky ball...
Rem is very strong, but doesn't that go for your guild too?
So please try not to be too scared.
text_block_list.orig_text:
初対面で鉄球をみちゃうと
そうかも……
レムは確かに強いけど、
【美食殿】のみんなも
かなりのものじゃない？
だから、
あまり怖がらないであげてね。
